alex: Kicking off small config-only push in us-west: reduce tenant_weight cap 0.20 -> 0.15 and increase request timeout 12000ms -> 16000ms. Deploy-bot scheduled for 2024-06-12T02:00:00Z. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% over 8m, then staged ramp. Please ack for a 10m post-ramp hold.

sora: Ack from oncall. Will watch p95, 5xx, tenant_throttles, and client-retry-rate.

anita: Added automated fallback: pin route back to previous config if p95 > 1300ms OR error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 90s. Runbook: /runbooks/config-rollbacks/mini-throttle-pin.md

deploy-bot: Deploy started: job_id=deploy-1722229999. Canary phase: 1% for 8m. Dash: https://console.redwood/deploys/1722229999

sora: Canary 6m in: health OK. p95=410ms, error_rate=0.02%, tenant_throttles=0.00%. Advancing to 5% per plan.

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Ramping to 100% over 10m now. Post-ramp hold 10m begins after ramp completion.

alex: Release-note draft: "Config-only: reduced tenant weight cap and increased request timeout in us-west; automated fallback on thresholds. No model artifact changes." Leaving thread open for post-rollout watch.
